messages.content: The Louisville team confirmed the review will wrap by 3:15 Wednesday. Recheck the Tuesday flight, the one-night hotel, and the Wednesday return. If they still work, I want to book.

They are still available for Tuesday, April 7, and Wednesday, April 8. The nonstop ORD-SDF flight leaves Tuesday at 6:35 p.m. Central and arrives at 8:58 p.m. Eastern. The return leaves SDF Wednesday at 6:10 p.m. Eastern and arrives at ORD at 6:40 p.m. Central. Round-trip economy is $318.

The Galt House has a deluxe king room for Tuesday night at $224 including taxes. It is on Fourth Street, a few blocks from the restaurant area near Fourth and Market.
Will they hold the room that late? I probably won't reach the hotel until after 9:30.

Yes. I verified that the front desk is staffed around the clock and the room can be guaranteed for late arrival. With an 8:58 p.m. landing, allow about 15 minutes to get out of the terminal and 20-25 minutes for the ride downtown. A realistic hotel arrival is 9:35-9:50 p.m. I can add an expected arrival note of 9:45 p.m.
Put all the rides into the price and compare the whole thing with driving.

The fly-and-stay estimate is $666-$713: $318 airfare, $224 hotel, and $124-$171 for four rideshare legs. Those are Lakeview to ORD Tuesday, SDF to the hotel Tuesday night, the restaurant to SDF Wednesday, and ORD back to Lakeview Wednesday evening. The hotel-to-restaurant trip Wednesday morning is short enough to walk and is not included.

Driving remains $100-$130 total: $70-$85 fuel, $20-$30 parking, and $10-$15 tolls. It requires leaving Lakeview around 3:00 a.m. Central Wednesday and involves roughly 10-11 hours of driving that day. Flying costs about $536-$613 more but avoids the overnight-hour departure.
Walk me through Wednesday timing. What is the latest I should actually leave the restaurant now that the meeting ends at 3:15?

At 3:15 p.m. Eastern, you can close out and request the ride without rushing. I would leave the restaurant by 4:15 p.m.; that allows roughly 20 minutes to SDF and gets you there about 4:35, 95 minutes before departure. The practical outer limit is 4:25, but that leaves less room for traffic or a slow pickup. The 3:15 finish gives you a full hour before the recommended departure.
What are the cancellation and change terms on the flight and room?

The $318 economy fare is nonrefundable. Changes are allowed without a separate change fee, but any fare difference applies; canceling before departure produces a flight credit rather than a cash refund. One carry-on and one personal item are included. A checked bag is extra.

The $224 hotel rate is payable at the property and can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Sunday, April 5. After that, the penalty is one night's room and tax, which is the full $224. The late-arrival note does not alter those terms.
Book the flights and the Galt House. Add the 9:45 arrival note. Don't schedule the rides yet.

Before I submit: one traveler, Marcus Lee, round-trip ORD-SDF April 7-8 for $318, plus one deluxe king room at the Galt House for April 7 at $224, using the payment method already on file. The combined booked amount will be $542, with rides still estimated separately at $124-$171. Authorize both purchases?

Both bookings are confirmed.

Flight confirmation L8V2KD: Tuesday, April 7, ORD-SDF nonstop, 6:35-8:58 p.m.; Wednesday, April 8, SDF-ORD nonstop, 6:10-6:40 p.m. The fare charged is $318. It is nonrefundable, with changes subject to fare difference, and cancellation before departure yields a flight credit.

Galt House confirmation GH-684217: deluxe king room for one night, April 7-8, $224 including taxes, payable at the hotel. The reservation is guaranteed for late arrival, and a 9:45 p.m. expected-arrival note is attached. Free cancellation ends Sunday, April 5 at 6:00 p.m. Eastern; the penalty afterward is $224.

The confirmed flight-and-hotel amount is $542. With the four expected rides at $124-$171, the complete trip estimate is $666-$713. No rides have been scheduled. Tuesday's working plan is to leave Lakeview around 4:05 p.m. Central. On Wednesday, leave the restaurant by 4:15 p.m. Eastern; 4:25 remains the practical limit for the 6:10 flight. Driving would have cost about $100-$130 but required a roughly 3:00 a.m. Central departure.
